hebrewText: וְ/כִֽי יִהְיֶ֤ה בַ/קָּרַ֨חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַ/גַּבַּ֔חַת נֶ֖גַע לָבָ֣ן אֲדַמְדָּ֑ם צָרַ֤עַת פֹּרַ֨חַת֙ הִ֔וא בְּ/קָרַחְתּ֖/וֹ א֥וֹ בְ/גַבַּחְתּֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: a bald spot (on the back of the head); figuratively, a threadbare spot (on the back side of the cloth)
desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
tokens.kjv: also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.

tokens.bdb: baldness in the forehead; by analogy, a bare spot on the right side of cloth

tokens.bdb: a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress)
tokens.kjv: plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

tokens.bdb: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish
tokens.kjv: [idiom] abroad, [idiom] abundantly, blossom, break forth (out), bud, flourish, make fly, grow, spread, spring (up).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to break forth as a bud
tokens.enLiteralWord: to break forth as a bud
tokens.explanation: to break forth as a bud
tokens.explanationEn: to break forth as a bud
